fields.PRODUCT NAME: The Divine Brass Bal Gopal Idol
fields.DESCRIPTION: This intricately crafted brass idol depicts Bal Gopal, the playful child form of Lord Krishna, crawling with a modak (sweet) in hand. This statue brings a sense of joyful innocence and devotion to any space. It's a perfect centerpiece for your puja room or a decorative piece that adds a touch of traditional artistry and spiritual charm to your home.
